SELECT DISTINCT Name
FROM singer
WHERE Net_Worth_Millions > 0 AND Sales > 300000

SELECT s.Name, s.Sales
FROM singer s
JOIN song ON s.Singer_ID = song.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Name, s.Singer_ID

SELECT MIN(Weight) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 8 AND Year = 1974

SELECT MAX(Accelerate) 
FROM car_names 
WHERE Cylinders = ( SELECT MAX(Cylinders) FROM car_names )

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cars_data 
WHERE Accelerate > (SELECT MAX(Horsepower) FROM cars_data)
SELECT MAX(T2.MPG) FROM car_names AS T1 INNER JOIN cars_data AS T2 ON T1.Model = T2.Model WHERE T2.Cylinders = 8 AND T2.Year < 1980

SELECT MAX(T2.MPG) 
FROM car_names AS T1 
JOIN cars_data AS T2 
ON T1.Model = T2.Model 
WHERE T2.Cylinders = 8 OR T2.Year < 1980
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Model FROM car_names AS T1 INNER JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Model = T2.Model WHERE T2.Maker != 'Ford' AND T1.Model < '3500'
SELECT T2.CountryName FROM car_makers AS T1 INNER JOIN countries AS T2 ON T1.Country = T2.CountryId WHERE T1.Country IS NULL

SELECT C.CountryId, C.CountryName
FROM countries C
JOIN car_makers M ON C.Country = M.Country
JOIN model_list ML ON M.Id = ML.Maker
JOIN car_names CN ON ML.Model = CN.Model
WHERE M.Country NOT IN (SELECT Country FROM car_makers WHERE CountryId IN (SELECT Country FROM countries WHERE Continent = 1)) 
AND CN.Model = 'fiat'
SELECT Name, Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Average = ( SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium ) ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(Airline) FROM airlines

FROM flights AS f 
JOIN airlines AS a ON f.Airline = a.uid

FROM flights

FROM evaluation

FROM Ref_Template_Types

SELECT 
  c.concert_Name, 
  c.Theme, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.Singer_ID) AS num_singers
FROM 
  concert c
  JOIN singer_in_concert si ON c.concert_ID = si.concert_ID
  JOIN singer s ON si.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
GROUP BY 
  c.concert_Name, 
  c.Theme, 
  s.Singer_ID

FROM Paragraphs 
WHERE Paragraph_Text LIKE '%Korea%'
SELECT T1.Age, T1.Hometown FROM teacher AS T1 INNER JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID = T2.Teacher_ID
SELECT Name FROM teacher WHERE Age = '32' OR Age = '33'
SELECT T1.Name FROM teacher AS T1 INNER JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID = T2.Teacher_ID GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
SELECT T1.Name FROM teacher AS T1 INNER JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID = T2.Teacher_ID WHERE T2.Grade IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(player_id) FROM players

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.birth_date
FROM players AS T1
JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id
JOIN players AS T3 ON T2.player_id = T3.player_id
WHERE T3.country_code = 'USA'

SELECT AVG(loser_age) AS avg_loser_age, AVG(winner_age) AS avg_winner_age
FROM matches

SELECT AVG(winner_rank) AS avg_winner_rank
FROM matches
WHERE winner_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT MAX(winner_rank) AS highest_rank FROM matches
SELECT T2.tourney_name FROM matches AS T1 INNER JOIN tournaments AS T2 ON T1.tourney_id = T2.tourney_id GROUP BY T2.tourney_name HAVING COUNT(T1.match_num) > 10

SELECT 
    first_name, 
    first_name || ' ' || r.ranking AS first_name_ranking, 
    SUM(r.ranking_points) AS total_ranking_points
FROM 
    players p
JOIN 
    rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id
GROUP BY 
    first_name, 
    first_name || ' ' || r.ranking AS first_name_ranking

SELECT country_code
FROM players
GROUP BY country_code
HAVING COUNT(player_id) > 50

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.country_code, T1.birth_date
FROM players T1
JOIN matches T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.winner_id
JOIN rankings T3 ON T2.match_num = T3.match_num
WHERE T3.ranking_points = (SELECT MAX(ranking_points) FROM rankings)

SELECT name, result, bulgarian_commander
FROM battle
WHERE location = 'English Channel' AND lost_in_battle = 0

SELECT line_1, line_2 
FROM Addresses
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Courses

SELECT T1.course_description 
FROM Courses AS T1 
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 
ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id 
WHERE T1.course_name = 'Math'

SELECT COUNT(PetID) 
FROM Has_Pet 
WHERE StuID IN (SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE Age > 20)

SELECT section_name
FROM Sections
ORDER BY section_name DESC

SELECT DISTINCT semester_name 
FROM Semesters 
WHERE semester_id NOT IN (SELECT semester_id FROM Student_Enrolment)
SELECT T1.semester_name FROM Semesters AS T1 INNER JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.semester_id = T2.semester_id WHERE T2.student_id IS NULL

SELECT T2.transcript_date, T1.student_course_id
FROM Transcripts T1
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses T2 ON T1.transcript_id = T2.transcript_id
WHERE T2.student_course_id NOT IN (SELECT student_course_id FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses WHERE student_enrolment_id IN (SELECT student_enrolment_id FROM Student_Enrolment WHERE degree_program_id IN (SELECT degree_program_id FROM Degree_Programs WHERE department_id IN (SELECT department_id FROM Departments WHERE department_name = 'Computer Science')))) AND T2.student_course_id IN (SELECT student_course_id FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses WHERE student_enrolment_id IN (SELECT student_enrolment_id FROM Student_Enrolment WHERE degree_program_id IN (SELECT degree_program_id FROM Degree_Programs WHERE department_id IN (SELECT department_id FROM Departments WHERE department_name = 'Computer Science')))))

SELECT T1.cell_mobile_number 
FROM Students AS T1 
JOIN Transcripts AS T2 
ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id 
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Timmothy' AND T1.last_name = 'Ward'

SELECT s.semester_name
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sec ON s.student_id = sec.student_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON sec.student_enrolment_id = se.student_enrolment_id
WHERE se.degree_program_id IN (13, 2) AND s.first_name = 'Timmothy' AND s.last_name = 'Anna'
SELECT Title FROM Cartoon ORDER BY Title

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Fname 
FROM Student T1 
JOIN Has_Pet T2 ON T1.StuID = T2.StuID 
JOIN Pets T3 ON T2.PetID = T3.PetID 
WHERE T3.PetType = 'cat' AND T3.PetType = 'dog'

SELECT T1.Series_name 
FROM TV_Channel T1 
JOIN Cartoon C ON T1.id = C.id 
WHERE C.Title = 'The Rise of the Blue Beetle!'
SELECT Weekly_Rank FROM TV_series WHERE Episode = 'A Love of a Lifetime'

SELECT T2.Package_Option, T1.Series_name
FROM TV_Channel T1
JOIN TV_series T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel
WHERE T1.Hight_definition_TV = 'yes'

SELECT T2.Package_Option
FROM TV_Channel T1
JOIN Cartoon C ON T1.id = C.id
WHERE C.Directed_by != 'Ben Jones' AND T1.Country != 'Italy'
SELECT MAX("Final_Table_Made") FROM poker_player WHERE Earnings < 200000
SELECT Name FROM people
SELECT People_ID FROM poker_player ORDER BY Final_Table_Made ASC
SELECT MAX(Money_Rank) FROM poker_player WHERE Height = ( SELECT MAX(Height) FROM people )

SELECT AVG(Earnings) 
FROM poker_player 
WHERE People_ID > 200

SELECT 
    V.created, 
    A.state, 
    V.phone_number
FROM 
    VOTES V
JOIN 
    AREA_CODE_STATE A ON V.state = A.state
JOIN 
    CONTESTANTS C ON V.contestant_number = C.contestant_number
WHERE 
    C.contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling'

SELECT T2.contestant_name
FROM VOTES T1
JOIN CONTESTANTS T2 ON T1.contestant_number = T2.contestant_number
WHERE T2.contestant_name LIKE '%Al%'
SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE Code = 'AN'
SELECT T2.Continent FROM city AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T1.Name = 'Anguilla'

SELECT 
    SUM(Population) AS TotalPopulation,
    MAX(GNP) AS MaxGNP
FROM 
    city
WHERE 
    Continent = 'Asia'
SELECT Population FROM city WHERE District = 'Gelderland'

SELECT DISTINCT Continent
FROM countrylanguage
WHERE Language = 'Chinese'

SELECT T1.Name
FROM city T1
JOIN countrylanguage T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode
WHERE T2.Language = 'English' AND T1.Population = (SELECT MAX(T1.Population) FROM city T1 WHERE T1.CountryCode = T2.CountryCode)
SELECT StuID FROM Has_Pet WHERE PetID IN (SELECT PetID FROM Student WHERE LName = 'Smith')

SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
WHERE c.Continent = 'Europe' AND c.SurfaceArea > (
  SELECT MAX(SurfaceArea)
  FROM country
  WHERE Continent = 'Europe'
)

SELECT c.Name, c.Name, l.HeadOfState
FROM city c
JOIN country AS t ON c.CountryCode = t.Code
JOIN countrylanguage AS l ON t.Code = l.CountryCode
WHERE t.SurfaceArea = ( SELECT MAX(SurfaceArea) FROM country ) ORDER BY t.SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  c.Continent, 
  AVG(LifeExpectancy) AS avg_life_expectancy, 
  SUM(Population) AS total_population
FROM 
  country c
  JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
  JOIN city ci ON cl.CountryCode = ci.CountryCode
WHERE 
  cl.IsOfficial = 'F' AND 
  cl.Percentage < 72 AND 
  c.Continent != 'Asia'
GROUP BY 
  c.Continent
ORDER BY 
  avg_life_expectancy DESC

SELECT Name, SurfaceArea 
FROM country 
ORDER BY SurfaceArea DESC 
LIMIT 5

SELECT MAX(Share) AS max_share, MIN(Share) AS min_share
FROM performance
WHERE Type != 'Live final'

SELECT Name 
FROM conductor 
WHERE Conductor_ID IN (
  SELECT Conductor_ID 
  FROM orchestra 
  GROUP BY Conductor_ID 
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT ID FROM Highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Highschooler 
WHERE grade IN (9, 10)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT friend_id) FROM Friend WHERE student_id = ( SELECT ID FROM Highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle' )

SELECT DISTINCT T2.student_id
FROM Friend T2
JOIN Likes T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.liked_id
SELECT T1.name FROM Highschooler AS T1 INNER JOIN Likes AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.liked_id GROUP BY T1.ID ORDER BY COUNT(T2.liked_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(liked_id) FROM Likes WHERE student_id = ( SELECT ID FROM Highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle' )
SELECT COUNT(CountryId) FROM countries

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name
FROM Owners AS T1
LEFT JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id
LEFT JOIN Professionals AS T3 ON T2.owner_id = T3.owner_id
WHERE T1.first_name NOT IN (SELECT first_name FROM Dogs)

SELECT 
    P.role_code,
    P.street,
    P.city,
    P.state
FROM 
    Professionals P
WHERE 
    P.city LIKE '%West%'

SELECT 
    O.first_name, 
    O.last_name, 
    O.email_address
FROM 
    Owners O
WHERE 
    O.state LIKE '%North%'

SELECT O.first_name, O.last_name, O.email_address
FROM Owners O
WHERE O.state LIKE '%North%'

SELECT T.cost_of_treatment
FROM Treatments T
ORDER BY T.date_of_treatment DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT owner_id)
FROM Owners
WHERE owner_id NOT IN (
  SELECT dog_id
  FROM Dogs
  WHERE abandoned_yn = '0'
)

SELECT T1.first_name, T2.treatment_type_description 
FROM Professionals AS T1 
JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
